name: Bitbucket-Runner
description: Self-hosted Bitbucket Pipelines runner (Linux Shell). Executes pipeline steps directly on the container without Docker, so you are not charged for build minutes. Requires OpenJDK 25 and Git; steps run as root on the host and share the build environment.

notes.text: The runner credentials (Account UUID, Runner UUID, OAuth Client ID/Secret) are shown only once in the Bitbucket runner setup dialog - copy them before finishing the setup, they cannot be retrieved again.

This is the Linux Shell runner: steps execute directly on the container as root without Docker, so there is no clean build environment per step. Use the 'linux.shell' label in runs-on in your bitbucket-pipelines.yml. Service containers, Pipes and SSH keys are not supported.
The runner needs outbound access to Atlassian endpoints and to AWS S3 (us-east-1) for artifacts and caches. If you use IP-based whitelisting, allow the S3 ranges from ip-ranges.amazonaws.com.
Build logs and caches persist in /opt/bitbucket-runner_data. The runner does not clean the cache folder after steps, so schedule a cleanup if it grows too large.
